question: Which 4 immune cell markers distinguish macrophages (Cluster 7) from T cells (Cluster 9) in the newborn lung?

nodes.label: Identify the specific newborn lung scRNA-seq dataset and load expression matrix and cell metadata
Confirm cluster annotations and locate macrophage Cluster 7 and T cell Cluster 9 in the metadata
Subset expression data to cells belonging to Cluster 7 (macrophages) and Cluster 9 (T cells)
Inspect known canonical macrophage markers (e.g., LST1, MARCO, CD68, MSR1, APOE, SPP1) and T cell markers (e.g., CD3D, CD3E, CD4, CD8A, TRAC) in the newborn lung dataset
Perform differential expression analysis between Cluster 7 and Cluster 9 to identify genes significantly upregulated in macrophages vs T cells
Filter DE genes for immune-related and surface or lineage markers using gene annotations and prior immunology knowledge
Rank macrophage-enriched immune markers by effect size and specificity compared with T cells
Assess expression distribution of top macrophage markers across all clusters to ensure they are not broadly expressed in T cells or other lineages
Perform reciprocal check of T cell canonical markers to ensure they are low or absent in macrophage Cluster 7
Select four macrophage markers that are robustly and specifically higher in Cluster 7 than in Cluster 9 and are interpretable as immune cell markers
Load newborn lung scRNA-seq AnnData object and associated metadata from CELLxGENE
Verify cluster identities and map Cluster 7 to macrophages and Cluster 9 to T cells using metadata column (e.g., 'leiden' or 'cluster')
Subset AnnData object to cells where cluster == '7' or cluster == '9' and store cluster labels
Plot and summarize expression of canonical macrophage markers (LST1, MARCO, CD68, MSR1, APOE, SPP1) and T cell markers (CD3D, CD3E, CD4, CD8A, TRAC) across clusters 7 and 9
Run differential expression analysis (e.g., scanpy.tl.rank_genes_groups with method='wilcoxon') comparing Cluster 7 (macrophages) vs Cluster 9 (T cells)
Filter DE results for genes significantly upregulated in Cluster 7 with immune-related and surface/lineage annotations using external gene annotation tables and known macrophage marker lists
Rank macrophage-enriched immune markers by log2 fold change, adjusted p-value, and specificity score between Cluster 7 and Cluster 9
Visualize expression distributions (violin, dot, or heatmap plots) of top-ranked macrophage markers across all clusters to confirm minimal expression in T cells and other lineages
Quantify and visualize expression of canonical T cell markers (CD3D, CD3E, CD4, CD8A, TRAC) in Cluster 7 to ensure low or absent expression
Select four macrophage markers that are robustly and specifically higher in Cluster 7 than Cluster 9, immune-related, and with low expression in T cells
